title: Locations
subtitle: The business's locations with address, contacts, opening hours, holidays and closures. A location is deactivated, never deleted.
loadError: The locations could not be loaded.
notFound: This location does not exist in this business.
readOnly: Only a manager of this business changes its locations.
saveError: The location could not be saved.

actions.lastActive: The last active location stays active – a business always has at least one.
actions.deactivateConfirm: The location {{name}} will be deactivated. Documents that name it stay unchanged; it can no longer be assigned to new users.

master.title: Master data
master.name: Name
master.codeHint: A short, fixed code such as ZH-NORD – it appears in document numbers and marketplace mappings and cannot be changed once saved.
master.typesHint: Several may apply – most locations are two of these, e.g. showroom and workshop.

address.title: Address and map
address.geoHint: WGS 84 in decimal degrees, e.g. 47.414100 and 8.546900 – for marketplaces and the website map.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.leadEmailHint: Marketplace enquiries for this location are sent here.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.perDepartmentHint: Off: one set of hours for the whole location, stored alike for sales, service and parts.
hours.invalid: Check the hours on {{day}}: each end after its start, the second interval after the first.

holidays.title: Holidays and closures
holidays.calendarHint: The cantonal holidays equal to Sundays and 1 August – per region where they differ within the canton. Maintained by Nexotec (source: SECO).
holidays.closuresHint: Company holidays and single closed days of this location – in addition to the public holidays.

overrides.title: Overrides of the business
overrides.disclosure: Letterhead and bank account of this location
overrides.letterheadHint: Empty: the business's address block. Replaces only the address block of the shared template, never the template.
